text:
samir: Quick question — for the JS SDK publish, should we ship a single package with conditional exports or split into @redwood/sdk (esm) + @redwood/sdk-cjs? Edge runtimes only support ESM, but a lot of Node apps still use require. Also types entry point confusion: point "types" to ./dist/index.d.ts or to ./esm/index.d.ts? Thoughts?

marta: Single package is much nicer for users. Conditional exports are fiddly but avoid duplicate release cycles. +1 for single package if build stays straightforward.

liang: FWIW edge environments can't use some Node auth helpers (no fs/kms), we had to ship an edge shim. Conditional exports can trip bun/deno/bundlers if you don't include explicit paths. My suggestion: use an explicit exports map and clear fallback files.

ben_s: Types resolution is the real headache. TS + conditional exports + typesVersions + older bundlers = weird edgecases. Another pattern that worked: provide index.cjs and index.mjs at root, set "main" -> cjs, "module" -> esm, and keep exports map minimal. Types still point to dist/index.d.ts.

samir: Can you sketch the package.json bits? I can try a prototype this afternoon.

liang: Sure, rough snippet:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./esm/index.js",
    "require": "./cjs/index.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"main": "./cjs/index.js",
"module": "./esm/index.js",
"types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
```

marta: Also document auth/retry differences for edge: no long-lived sockets, no agent keepalive, use fetch polyfills, and only safe idempotent retries there. We tripped customers when retry logic did non-idempotent tries in Vercel Edge.

devex-bot: Reminder: PR #1423 adds a conditional-exports test matrix. CI is failing on an older runner that resolves exports differently — node 18 vs node 20 differences. We should pin test runners.

publish-bot: Heads-up — publishing two packages means duplicate CVE patches and twice the release choreography. Ops prefers single-package if possible.

ben_s: If we go single-package, add a smoke test suite: require('redwood-sdk') in a CJS runner, import in ESM runner, run in Cloudflare worker and Next Edge function. Also add a types smoke check for TS project resolving types from the package root.

samir: Great—I'll prototype single-package with explicit dual entrypoints + exports map and a tiny test harness that runs the above cases. Assigning to myself, will ping when draft is on a branch. :rocket:
